channel.title: LoLaBo — Lorapok Labs Blog
channel.description: Notes on public Lorapok Labs repositories, written from each project's README.

item.title: Deep Dive: Architecting Lock-Free LSM-B+Tree Engines: SIMD Vector Clocks, Page Recirculation, and Bounded WAL Shadowing
item.author: lorapokdev@gmail.com (Captain Deploy)
item.description: An in-depth systems analysis of building zero-allocation, crash-consistent edge storage engines optimized for low-connectivity environments, featuring lock-free skiplist memtables and SIMD-accelerated vector clock reconciliation.

item.title: Lorapok Inventory System keeps each shop in its own database
item.author: lorapokdev@gmail.com (Mohammad Maizied Hasan Majumder)
item.description: The Lorapok-Inventory-System README describes a multi-tenant point of sale where each shop has its own subdomain, branding, and database.

item.title: MindNode encrypts notes in the browser before they are stored
item.author: lorapokdev@gmail.com (Mohammad Maizied Hasan Majumder)
item.description: The MindNode README describes a key-based notepad that encrypts notes with the Web Crypto API and does not keep server-side keys.

item.title: Lorapok Atlas is a dashboard for browsing public APIs
item.author: lorapokdev@gmail.com (Mohammad Maizied Hasan Majumder)
item.description: The Atlas README describes a directory where developers browse and live-test public APIs. The same repository is published under both @Maijied and @Lorapok.

item.title: Cursor Curse Monitor reads Cursor usage on the local machine
item.author: lorapokdev@gmail.com (Mohammad Maizied Hasan Majumder)
item.description: The extension README describes a dashboard for Cursor limits, remaining quota, billing-cycle reset, and on-demand spend.

item.title: Loragent is a multi-agent catalog with 224 skill definitions on this site
item.author: lorapokdev@gmail.com (Mohammad Maizied Hasan Majumder)
item.description: The Loragent README describes an orchestration framework for IDE agents. The skill index in this repository counts 224 definitions.

item.title: SeeYou audits a site the way a crawler renders it
item.author: lorapokdev@gmail.com (Mohammad Maizied Hasan Majumder)
item.description: The SeeYou README describes an agentic SEO tool with a remote MCP server, a hosted API, and a dashboard.

item.title: Architecting Deterministic Replay Systems: High-Fidelity State Reconstruction for Autonomous Agentic Runtimes
item.author: lorapokdev@gmail.com (Captain Deploy)
item.description: A deep dive into the engineering of deterministic event-loop replay systems, focusing on syscall virtualization, non-deterministic input masking, and memory-safe state serialization for auditing agentic decision-making.

item.title: FreqGhost visualizes WiFi sensing and vital signs
item.author: lorapokdev@gmail.com (Mohammad Maizied Hasan Majumder)
item.description: The FreqGhost README describes a WiFi sensing observatory that maps motion and estimates respiration and heart rate from channel state information.

item.title: ReportKit is a PHP report stack for Laravel and plain PHP
item.author: lorapokdev@gmail.com (Mohammad Maizied Hasan Majumder)
item.description: The ReportKit README describes a prepare, store, compose, and send flow that targets current Laravel and older plain-PHP deployments.

item.title: Roast as a Service is a static JSON API of developer roasts
item.author: lorapokdev@gmail.com (Mohammad Maizied Hasan Majumder)
item.description: The roast-as-a-service README describes a static API on GitHub Pages that returns developer roasts for apps, bots, terminals, or CI logs.

item.title: dCursor runs a second Cursor instance beside the first
item.author: lorapokdev@gmail.com (Mohammad Maizied Hasan Majumder)
item.description: The dCursor README describes a Debian package that mirrors Cursor with a separate account, extensions, agent, MCP servers, and settings.

item.title: Architecting Disaggregated GPU Memory Fabrics: RDMA-Accelerated KV-Cache Offloading via CUDA Unified Virtual Addressing
item.author: lorapokdev@gmail.com (Captain Deploy)
item.description: A formal analysis of disaggregated inference architectures, detailing the implementation of RDMA-backed KV-cache offloading to overcome GPU VRAM bottlenecks in high-concurrency LLM serving.

item.title: Architecting Interruptible Agentic Control Planes: Non-Blocking Pause Barriers and Kernel-Enforced Execution Abort Protocols for Autonomous Systems
item.author: lorapokdev@gmail.com (Captain Deploy)
item.description: An exhaustive engineering blueprint detailing kernel-level pause barriers, non-blocking asynchronous interrupt mechanics, and ring-buffer abort protocols for autonomous agents executing live system mutations.

item.title: Architecting Distributed Continuous-Evaluation Fabrics for Foundation Models: MicroVM Snapshot Cloning, Lock-Free Trace Buses, and Sharded Metric Quorums
item.author: lorapokdev@gmail.com (Captain Deploy)
item.description: A deep architectural blueprint for enterprise-grade autonomous model verification, detailing hardware-assisted microVM snapshot isolation, zero-copy IPC trace buses, and Byzantine-fault-tolerant metric quorum consensus.

item.title: Deep Dive: Architecting Decentralized Autonomous Coding Agent State Fabrics via Local Memory Inspectors, Lock-Free Ring Buffers, and AST-Driven Hashing
item.author: lorapokdev@gmail.com (Captain Deploy)
item.description: An exhaustive systems-engineering breakdown of local memory inspection engines and lock-free ring buffers for multi-agent coding swarms, mitigating the 'vibe-coding' trap through deterministic AST-driven state synchronization.

item.title: RFC-0182: Deterministic Fault-Injection Frameworks for Agentic State Machines via Hardware-Assisted Taint Tracking
item.author: lorapokdev@gmail.com (Captain Deploy)
item.description: A formal specification for embedding deterministic fault-injection into autonomous agent runtimes to validate safety invariants against non-deterministic LLM output and systemic environment drift.

item.title: Architecting a Multi-Modal Ingestion Engine for Robotics Foundation Models: Real-Time Sensor Alignment, Zero-Copy Ring Buffers, and GPUDirect Storage Integration
item.author: lorapokdev@gmail.com (Captain Deploy)
item.description: Discover how to design a high-throughput, low-latency ingestion pipeline for Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models. Learn to eliminate CPU-GPU bottlenecking using RoCEv2, lock-free ring buffers, and GPUDirect Storage.
